textRuns.value: Proposed control actions: monitor solder paste height with Xbar-R charts; review abnormal PCB defect periods using the p-chart; verify stencil-cleaning procedure execution; evaluate Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk only after stability review; prioritize recurring high-impact defect categories with Pareto. These are proposed actions; the synthetic source data contains no stencil-cleaning execution, maintenance, approval, or operator-accountability records.
